actor.description: A person or role that interacts with your systems, e.g. a customer or support agent

app.description: An application that runs code or performs tasks within a system, e.g. a web app, API or microservice

component.description: A logical building block within an app or store, e.g. a module, controller or library

group.description: A collection of related objects, e.g. a team, department or business capability

root.description: The root object of a domain that all other objects descend from

store.description: A place where data or files are stored within a system, e.g. a database, file storage or message queue

system.description: A software system that delivers value to its users, e.g. an e-commerce platform or CRM
